newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil deputies reject re-election referendum.
newsitem.headline: Brazil deputies reject re-election referendum.

text.p: Brazil's Chamber of Deputies rejected a proposal for a national referendum on President Fernando Henrique Cardoso's plan to stand for a second term, an official said.
The proposed alteration to a constitutional amendment allowing re-election, which was approved in the lower house on Tuesday, was floated by opposition parties, the official said.
But they failed to muster the three-fifths majority in the lower house needed for approval of the alteration, he said.

The Chamber of Deputies was due to vote on a final proposed change to the re-election amendment. But a spokeswoman for government chief whip Benito Gama said the last item was merely a technical change and did not affect the re-election bill.
